title: Code and data: coupled gold-nanorod heating and thermoradiobiology for mild thermoradiotherapy planning
description: Python code (Gans optics of gold nanorods, delta-P1 and Monte Carlo light transport, Pennes bioheat, extended linear-quadratic thermoradiobiology, gold dose enhancement, ANN, gradient-boosted and smooth-function surrogates, exhaustive and robust design, uncertainty analysis, superficial-site sensitivity and heterogeneous nanorod distributions) and the 288,000-sample design dataset for the article 'Gold nanorods as heaters, not dose enhancers: planning mild thermoradiotherapy within skin exposure limits'.
